title: When the Landfall Falls
author: Jude Eriksen
blurb: Quentin Kavanagh, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
